text: On May 14th, Admiral Karl Dönitz met Hitler. According to Dönitz's own record, Hitler did not agree with Mussolini that Sicily was the most likely target. He believed the captured Anglo-Saxon order confirmed that the attacks would be aimed mainly at Sardinia and the Peloponnese.
spoken: On May fourteenth, Admiral Karl Dernitz met Hitler. According to Dernitz's own record, Hitler did not agree with Mussolini that Sicily was the most likely target. He believed the captured Anglo-Saxon order confirmed that the attacks would be aimed mainly at Sardinia and the Peloponnese.
